entries.10.32: एवम् thus, सः he, महातेजाः of great splendour, ऋष्यश्रृंगः Rishyashringa, शान्तया भार्यया सह along with his wife Shanta, सर्वकामैः with every desire, सुपूजितः well honoured, तत्र there, न्यवसत् dwelt
entries.13.11.1: वाजिवारणशालाश्च and stables for horses and elephants, तथा likewise, शय्यागृहाणि च and sleeping quarters, वैदेशिकनिवासिनाम् for those lodging from abroad, भटानाम् of the soldiers, महदावासाः great dwellings
entries.14.58: सः he, नृपेन्द्रः the lord of kings, महात्मा the great-souled, प्रयतः composed, तस्य his, मधुरम् sweet, वाक्यम् speech, निशम्य having heard, तस्मै to him, प्रणम्य having bowed, परमम् the utmost, हर्षम् joy, जगाम came to, पुनः अपि once again, तम् that, ऋष्यश्रृंगम् Rishyashringa, उवाच addressed
entries.21.18.1: राघव O Raghava, तेन thereby, धर्मज्ञस्य of the knower of dharma, महात्मनः the great-souled, अस्य this, मुनिमुख्यस्य foremost of sages, भूतम् what has been, भव्यं च and what is to be, किञ्चित् anything, अविदितम् unknown, न अस्ति there is not
entries.22.7.1: अक्षुद्रौ no mean pair, श्रिया with splendour, दीप्तौ blazing, अनुयातौ following after, शोभयन्तौ making all fair, अनिन्दितौ blameless, अश्विनौ इव like the Ashvins, पितामहम् the Grandsire, अनुजग्मतुः followed
entries.30.25: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, अहम् I, कृतार्थः अस्मि have attained my end, त्वया by you, गुरुवचः the word of your teacher, कृतम् has been fulfilled, वीर O hero, महायशः O greatly renowned one, इदम् this, सिद्धाश्रमम् Siddhashrama, सत्यम् true to its name, कृतम् has been made, सः he, रामम् Rama, एवम् thus, प्रशस्य having praised, ताभ्याम् with those two, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, उपागमत् came to
entries.40.30: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, ततः then, अप्रमेयेण by the immeasurable, महात्मना great-souled, कपिलेन Kapila, सर्वे all, सगरात्मजाः the sons of Sagara, भस्मराशीकृताः were reduced to heaps of ash
entries.45.2.1: परंतप O scorcher of foes, तव your, इमाम् this, सर्वाम् entire, कथाम् tale, निखिलेन in full, चिन्तयतोः as we two pondered, इयम् this, रात्रिः night, क्षणभूता इव as though it were but a moment, संवृत्ता has passed
entries.61.23: राजर्षिः the royal sage, महातेजाः of great splendour, महायशाः of great renown, अम्बरीषः तु and Ambarisha, सत्वरः in haste, शुनःशेपम् Shunahshepa, रथम् in the chariot, आरोप्य having set, आशु swiftly, जगाम went
entries.68.20: मन्त्रिणः the counsellors, सर्वैः with all, महर्षिभिः सह along with the great sages, बाढम् इति so be it, आहुः said, राजा the king, सुप्रीतः च and well pleased, मन्त्रिणः to the counsellors, श्वः tomorrow, यात्रा the journey, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said
entries.68.21: नरेन्द्रस्य of the lord of men, मन्त्रिणः तु and the counsellors, परमसत्कृताः most highly honoured, सर्वैः with all, गुणैः virtues, समन्विताः endowed, सर्वे all, प्रमुदिताः rejoicing, रात्रिम् the night, ऊषुः passed
entries.70.44: आदिवंशविशुद्धानाम् pure from the founding of their line, परमधर्मिणाम् most righteous, इक्ष्वाकुकुलजातानाम् born in the house of Ikshvaku, सत्यवादिनाम् truthful of speech, वीराणाम् of the heroes
entries.70.45: नृप O king, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, रामलक्ष्मणयोः for Rama and Lakshmana, अर्थे on behalf, ते your, सुते two daughters, वरये I ask in marriage, सदृशाभ्याम् to two who are their match, सदृशे the two who match them, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि you ought
entries.77.22.1: नरश्रेष्ठः the best of men, शत्रुघ्नसहितः together with Shatrughna, मातॄश्चापि and his mothers too, ययौ went, युधाजित् Yudhajit, सशत्रुघ्नम् along with Shatrughna, भरतम् Bharata, प्राप्य having obtained, प्रहर्षितः was greatly delighted
entries.77.31: विभुः the mighty, राजर्षिसुतः son of the royal sage, सः that, रामः Rama, अभिकामया who loved him, उत्तमराजकन्यया with that best of royal maidens, समेयिवान् united, मुदान्वितः filled with joy, अमरेश्वरः lord of the immortals, विष्णुः इव like Vishnu, श्रिया with Shri, अतीव exceedingly, शुशुभे shone
